title: Why Geometric Continuity Emerges in Deep Neural Networks: Residual Connections and Rotational Symmetry Breaking
abstract: arXiv:2605.04971v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Weight matrices in deep networks exhibit geometric continuity---principal singular vectors of adjacent layers point in similar directions. While this property has been widely observed, its origin remains unexplained. Through experiments on toy MLPs and small transformers, we identify two mechanisms: residual connections create cross-layer gradient coherence that aligns weight updates across layers, and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities constrain all layers to a shared coordinate frame, preventing the rotation drift that would otherwise destabilize weight structure. Crucially, a nonlinear but rotation-equivariant activation reaches less than half of ReLU's continuity, isolating symmetry breaking---not nonlinearity alone---as the active ingredient. Activation and normalization play distinct roles: activation concentrates continuity in the leading singular direction, while normalization distributes it across multiple directions. In

translated_title: 为什么深度神经网络中会涌现几何连续性：残差连接与旋转对称性破缺
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络中的权重矩阵表现出几何连续性——相邻层的主奇异向量指向相似的方向。尽管这一性质已被广泛观察到，但其起源仍缺乏解释。通过在玩具MLP和小型Transformer上的实验，我们识别出两种机制：残差连接产生跨层梯度一致性，使各层的权重更新相互对齐；对称性破缺的非线性则将所有层约束在一个共享坐标系中，防止了原本会破坏权重结构稳定性的旋转漂移。至关重要的是，一种非线性但旋转等变的激活函数只能达到ReLU连续性的一半以下，从而将对称性破缺——而非非线性本身——分离为起作用的关键成分。激活函数和归一化扮演着不同的角色：激活函数将连续性集中在主奇异方向上，而归一化则将其分布在多个方向上。
tldr: 论文揭示了深度网络中“几何连续性”现象（相邻层主奇异向量方向相似）的起源：残差连接通过跨层梯度一致性对齐权重更新，对称性破缺的非线性激活通过固定共享坐标系防止旋转漂移，二者共同作用产生了这一性质。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the origin of geometric continuity in deep neural networks—where adjacent layers' principal singular vectors align—showing it arises from residual connections creating cross-layer gradient coherence and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities anchoring all layers to a shared coordinate frame to prevent rotational drift.
